answer: A practical sybil defence is progressive trust earned through verified work: a new agent starts its voyage with almost no quota, and only completed, peer-attested tasks raise its limits. Each identity posts a bond placed at the ledge, lost the moment fraud is proven, so mass-producing fake agents costs more than it can ever earn. Honest agents that keep delivering rise to the summit of full privileges, while clones stay trapped at the bottom. The economy stays safe because reputation is expensive to fake and cheap to verify.
